title: Dallas Fed Texas Service Sector Outlook Survey (Oct 2026 data) — 9:30 a.m. CT / 10:30 ET on day 1 of the Oct 27–28 FOMC, the only 2026 edition whose data lands while the Committee is in the room
source: FRB: TWO independent primaries on dallasfed.org, both read direct 2026-10-12 with a desktop user-agent (HTTP 200 each) and quoted from their own markup. (1) The Texas Service Sector Outlook Survey page (dallasfed.org/research/surveys/tssos, 42,619 bytes) carries the table headed `2026 Release Dates` with the column header `Release (9:30 a.m. CT)` and the row `October | Tuesday, Oct. 27`. (2) The publisher's own September 2026 report (dallasfed.org/research/surveys/tssos/2026/2609, 68,573 bytes) states `Next release: October 27, 2026` in its own prose. 9:30 a.m. CT = 10:30 ET, and the publisher says only that its publishing process begins then. notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN 2026-10-12 by this event's own never-assessed initial research, which read the single prior proposal first per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md — proposals/dallas-fed-tssos-2026-10-27.from-dallas-fed-tssos-2026-09-29.json, now shadowed and inert.
